text:
Type: rust red linen-look cushion
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, bohemian, contemporary
Materials: woven linen-look fabric with a visible slub texture, flat seamed edge
Colors: warm rust red, brick orange
Shape: square plump cushion with a plain surface, slightly rounded corners, simple sewn edge, medium size
Feel: warm, earthy, relaxed
Goes with: natural wood, terracotta, cream or grey sofas, green plants; Scandinavian or bohemian living rooms

product.name: VIGDIS
product.description: The cushion cover is made of ramie, a hard-wearing natural material with a slightly irregular texture.
